content.text: The difference between a sovereign store and a manual operation is not scale — it is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-13|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-6|The Real]]. A manual operation requires your attention for every order. A sovereign store processes orders identically whether you are watching or not, whether it is midnight or noon, whether it receives one order or fifty simultaneously. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital-13|nowpayments]] monitors the blockchain continuously. The webhook fires the moment a transaction receives on-chain confirmations. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your Supabase database, generates a presigned download URL from Cloudflare R2 with a configurable expiry time, and sends the delivery email via Resend. The buyer receives their product before they have navigated away from the payment confirmation page.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows users to automate tasks across Google products. For digital creators, it serves as a bridge between their online store and the backend processes that handle order fulfillment. This is particularly important in regions where traditional payment processors are not available. By leveraging Google Apps Script, creators can ensure a seamless flow from payment confirmation to product delivery, significantly reducing the time and effort required to manage transactions manually. In a correctly configured sovereign stack, this automation can process orders in under 30 seconds, enabling creators to provide instantaneous service and maintain customer satisfaction.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a digital commerce system using Google Apps Script involves several interconnected components. At its core, the system utilizes a webhook that listens for payment confirmation events from NOWPayments. When a customer completes a transaction, the webhook triggers a Google Apps Script function, which handles order processing. This function updates the order status in a database, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and sends an email with download links to the customer. This entire process is efficient and scalable, capable of handling up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier of Cloudflare Workers, ensuring that creators can manage high volumes of transactions without incurring additional costs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automation solution is designed for digital creators across various regions facing payment processing challenges. Whether in Nigeria, Venezuela, or the Philippines, many creators are locked out of mainstream payment solutions, inhibiting their ability to monetize their work. By utilizing Google Apps Script in conjunction with NOWPayments and other cloud-based tools, these creators can establish a robust and independent online store. This independence not only enhances their operational efficiency but also fosters a sense of sovereignty over their digital commerce activities. The ease of use and flexibility offered by this stack empowers creators to focus on their craft rather than on navigating complex payment systems.
Automate your order fulfillment and regain control over your digital sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of this automated digital commerce solution hinges on several key components. Google Apps Script acts as the primary engine running the automation, interfacing with Google Sheets or Supabase for order storage. NOWPayments provides the necessary infrastructure for accepting cryptocurrency payments, ensuring that the payment process is both secure and efficient. Additionally, email services such as Resend or Gmail are leveraged for notifying customers post-purchase. Together, these components create a cohesive system that not only simplifies the transaction process but also enhances the overall user experience, allowing creators to deliver products instantly and manage their operations seamlessly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital commerce automation using Google Apps Script, start by setting up your environment. First, choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a robust framework for your store. Next, configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments. After that, create a Google Apps Script project to handle webhook events from NOWPayments. Ensure that your script updates the order status in Supabase or Google Sheets and sends delivery emails to customers. Finally, test the entire workflow to confirm that orders are processed correctly, and your customers receive their products promptly. Once tested, you can promote your shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The webhook secret is the security mechanism that prevents fake webhook injection. NOWPayments signs every webhook with an HMAC hash using the secret key you configured in your account. Your backend recomputes the hash using the same secret key and the raw webhook body. If the hashes match, the webhook is legitimate. If they do not match, the request is rejected before any order processing occurs. This validation happens in under one millisecond. Combined with the independent on-chain transaction verification that follows, it creates a two-layer security model that makes fraudulent order injection effectively impossible against a correctly configured sovereign stack.
Harness the power of Google Apps Script to streamline your commerce operations.

For creators looking to streamline their operations, exploring the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) can provide a powerful framework that integrates Google Apps Script and NOWPayments effectively. This solution makes automated digital delivery feasible, even in regions with limited payment options.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to establish a solid foundation. Next, set up your NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Create a Google Apps Script project to manage webhook events. Configure your order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. Implement email notifications for customer order fulfillment. Test the entire process to ensure everything works seamlessly before going live.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by connecting payment confirmation events from NOWPayments to a webhook. This webhook, when triggered, activates a Google Apps Script that processes the order and sends the product download link to the customer automatically.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a user-defined HTTP callback that triggers when a specific event occurs—in this case, a payment confirmation. Once the payment is verified by NOWPayments, the webhook sends the event data to a Google Apps Script that manages the order fulfillment process.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, you can automatically send download links following a crypto payment confirmation. By utilizing Google Apps Script, you can configure a system that monitors payment confirmations and sends the necessary product links to customers instantly.
What are the benefits of using Google Apps Script for digital commerce?

Google Apps Script offers flexibility and cost-effectiveness for automating digital commerce. It allows creators to integrate various Google services seamlessly, manage order fulfillment autonomously, and handle high transaction volumes without relying on costly third-party services.
How can I ensure my setup handles high order volumes?

To ensure your setup can handle high order volumes, utilize Cloudflare Workers, which can manage up to 100,000 webhook events per day on their free tier. This allows your system to scale without additional costs while maintaining quick response times.
